title: Certify many-sorted QF_UF refutations through one Lean carrier
summary: The QF_UF certification path now accepts inputs over any number of uninterpreted sorts: the certificate keeps every sort name, Python checks the proof graph is well-sorted, and Lean renders all sorts as one type under a documented soundness argument. Review found that overloaded symbol names let a certificate be rebound to a satisfiable input, so overloading is now rejected at the frontend and the binder checks full signatures.
